# WLP Live PA Template

**Generated by PriScylla 🦞 | 2026-04-06**

---

## Rig

```
Mac (Ableton + Push 2) ──USB──► MCX8000 (Ch 3/4 input)
                                    ↓
Push 2 ──USB──► Mac              MCX8000 Master Out ──► PA
```

---

## Session View Layout

| Track | Color | Role |
|-------|-------|------|
| DRUMS | 🟢 Green | Kick, snare, hats |
| PERC | 🟢 Green | Shakers, percussion layers |
| BASS | 🟢 Green | Sub / bass line |
| CHORDS | 🟡 Yellow | Pads, chords, atmosphere |
| LEAD | 🟡 Yellow | Melody, lead synth |
| VOCALS | 🟡 Yellow | Acapellas, vocal chops |
| FX | 🔵 Blue | Risers, downlifters, impacts |
| LOOPS | 🔵 Blue | Full loop stems, fills |
| REVERB (Return) | 🔵 Blue | Global verb send |
| DELAY (Return) | 🔵 Cyan | Global delay send |

---

## Scenes (Song Structure)

| Scene | Energy | Notes |
|-------|--------|-------|
| INTRO (Low Energy) | Low | Build tension, drums only or minimal |
| BUILD 1 | Rising | Add elements progressively |
| DROP 1 (Peak) | Full | Everything in |
| BREAKDOWN | Low | Strip back, pads/atmosphere only |
| BUILD 2 | Rising | Re-introduce, more intensity |
| DROP 2 (Peak) | Full | Second peak, variations |
| OUTRO | Falling | Wind down, extend outro |

---

## Push 2 Macro Knobs (8 knobs mapped)

| Knob | Parameter | Default |
|------|-----------|---------|
| 1 | Filter Cutoff | 127 (open) |
| 2 | Filter Resonance | 0 |
| 3 | Reverb Send | 0 |
| 4 | Delay Send | 0 |
| 5 | Volume | 100 |
| 6 | Distortion/Drive | 0 |
| 7 | Pitch/Transpose | 64 (center) |
| 8 | LFO Rate | 64 |

---

## Push 2 Mode Reference

| Mode | Button | Use |
|------|--------|-----|
| Session | Session | Launch clips/scenes |
| Note | Note | Play melodic parts live |
| Drum Rack | Pad grid | Fire samples |
| Device | Device | Control mapped macros |

## Sample Folder Structure

```
~/Music/Ableton/WLP-Live-PA/
├── Samples/
│   ├── Drums/         (kick, snare, hats — labeled KEY_BPM)
│   ├── Bass/
│   ├── Chords-Pads/
│   ├── Melodies-Leads/
│   ├── Vocals/
│   ├── FX/            (risers, impacts, sweeps)
│   └── Stems/         (full loop stems)
└── WLP-LivePA-Template.als
```

**Naming convention:** `DescriptiveName_KEY_BPM.wav`  
Example: `KickHard_Am_128.wav`

---

## MCX8000 Routing

- Ableton output → MCX8000 **Channel 3 or 4** (line input)
- Virtual DJ → MCX8000 Channels 1 & 2 (DJ decks)
- MCX8000 Master Out → PA system

Set MCX8000 input to **LINE** on Ch 3/4.  
Gain stage: start at 9 o'clock, adjust to match VDJ deck levels.

---

## Pre-Show Checklist

- [ ] Template loaded in Ableton
- [ ] MCX8000 Ch 3/4 input = LINE
- [ ] Push 2 connected + recognized in Ableton
- [ ] All clips labeled (Key + BPM)
- [ ] Master limiter on (-1dB ceiling)
- [ ] Test run through all scenes
- [ ] Return sends dialed in (reverb + delay)
- [ ] Backup laptop ready (optional)
